Planning and Zoning

The Department of Planning and Zoning works closely with communities to carry out the City Council's priorities, fostering amenity-rich, service-oriented and equity-balanced neighborhoods; protecting historic and cultural resources; and supporting diverse and creative businesses. Visit our "About Planning and Zoning" page to learn more about the Department's vision and planning values.

IMPORTANT SECURITY ALERT: FBI Warns of Scams Targeting Permit Applicants 

The FBI has warned of phishing scams targeting permit applicants. Scammers are impersonating city officials to request fraudulent payments via wire or apps. Alexandria will never ask for permit fees via cryptocurrency, wire transfer, or peer-to-peer apps (Venmo/Zelle). Visit alexandriava.gov/go/8046 for more information.

Historic Preservation
